description: Create (or upsert) an environment variable on a Vercel project. Target defaults to production, preview, and development. Use type='plain' for non-secret values, 'encrypted' or 'sensitive' for secrets.

target.description: CSV of environments: 'production,preview,development'. Defaults to all three.

type.description: plain | encrypted | sensitive | secret | system. Defaults to plain.

upsert.description: Overwrite existing value for same key/target. Default true.

name: vercel_create_env
